note: The one table of what each privacy category hides (cross-design Y24). An entry is a field name, or a pattern that starts with * for every field that ends so. A category's fields are removed from an answer at any depth. P&L is offered only together with quantities: while qty is hidden, pnl is hidden too, and everything qty hides is hidden with it. Never hidden: symbol, exchange, direction, product, the live price and its change, the market status, and today (the trading date; the P&L of the day is the paise, base_paise and pct inside a Today figure). Version 2 (phase P7): the fields of tax, risk, goals, dividends, the calendar, the benchmark statistics and exported files are hidden too, though no op of that phase is a family op (a family member sees none of them), so a field cannot reach a viewer by being forgotten; a closed-world test fails on any answer key no category, never_hidden or its reviewed structural list names.
